guide.description: Two lines of maths, repeated millions of times, drawn as silk. The four knobs are the four letters in the formula.

controls.action: The four knobs are a, b, c and d in the formula. Turn one and the whole figure bends.
Figures: choose the formula, one of its presets and the colours.
Player: the sound, the piece, and the show (Auto, Hold or Still). A tap on the picture opens it too.
Any knob: switch it between fine steps (0.01) and coarse steps (0.10).
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Next figure: the next preset of the formula, and after its last the next formula.
Figures: formula, preset, colours and the text on the picture. E1 moves through the choices, a press of E1 takes one, K3 closes.
Player: sound, piece and show. E1 moves through the choices, a press of E1 takes one, K4 closes.
Set it spinning. Drag to stop.
Mute or unmute the music, with a short fade. With the microphone or Silent, play the music.

sections.title: The show
sections.text: Player sets how the figure behaves. Auto: it performs by itself. It turns and tilts, its letters sway, the sound moves them, and where the music changes it slides to the next figure; after three figures it moves on to the next formula and colours. Hold: it performs in the same way and stays on this figure. Still: it rests, and sharpens as the points gather. The App opens in Auto. Turn a knob or choose a figure and Auto becomes Hold, so the show never changes what you have just set; choose Auto again to let it go on. On a large output a performing figure slowly grows past the edges and comes back. A shared link opens its one figure Still.

sections.title: The picture
sections.text: Each formula takes a point and gives the next one. The App follows many points at once and counts where they land: the more often a place is hit, the brighter it is. Every figure has depth: for a two-line formula it is where each point was one step before. A three-line formula moves smoothly through space and is drawn as one long line wound into its figure. While anything moves the figure is a little grainy; at rest the points gather to several million and the picture becomes smooth, then stops. Some settings collapse to a few points, which the device screen says; K2 always leads back to a preset. A large output shows the figure only, with no text.

sections.title: Sound
sections.text: Music plays the two pieces that come with the App, Strange Loop and Sacred Orbit, in turn. A performing figure follows them from the first moment; where a browser allows sound only after a touch or a key, the sound joins then. Muted, the music plays on unheard and the figure keeps time. Mic / Line in follows the audio input instead, which is never played back or kept. Silent plays and follows nothing. The low, middle and high parts of the sound sway a, b and c, and sudden swells nudge d. A Still figure follows no sound. Choose inputs and outputs and set levels in Menu.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The formula, a, b, c and d, the colours, the view, the show, the sound, the piece, whether it is muted and whether the text shows save automatically. A shared link opens the same figure from the same side.
